# Tier `blackwell-2x16`

## Serving

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| backend | `dual-blackwell` | which `llama-swap.*.yaml` template renders |
| ctx_size | 131072 | the served window (`--ctx-size`) |
| kv_type | `q8_0` | `--cache-type-k/v`, kept symmetric |
| flash_attn | `on` | `--flash-attn` (required for a q8_0 V cache) |
| resident_tier | `gemma4-26b-a4b` | the model that stays hot; seeds the agent planner seat (agent_model) when it differs from the workhorse |
| agent_ctx_tokens | 163840 | the agent's `-ctx-tokens` compaction budget |
| 26B-A4B | `gpu` | whether the 26B MoE is served, and where its experts live |

## Agent seat

This tier declares a persistent **vLLM** agent seat, and the installer RENDERS it — the
llama-swap entry, the start/stop wrappers and the harness `agent_model` binding all derive from
one declaration, so the seat and the lane routing to it cannot disagree.

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| id | `qwen3.8-27b-vllm` | the llama-swap model id, `--served-model-name`, and what `agent_model` binds to |
| cards | `0,1` | `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`, in PCI order |
| tensor_parallel | 2 | `--tensor-parallel-size`; must equal how many cards are listed |
| max_model_len | 163840 | the served window |
| gpu_memory_utilization | 0.85 | the engine's share of the card — chosen WITH the seat's co-residents in mind, not alone |
| kv_cache_dtype | `fp8` | KV precision — backend-dependent, not free everywhere |
| ttl_seconds | 300 | idle window before the seat unloads and frees its cards |
| launch | `windows-wsl` | which artifact set starts it |
| fallback | `qwen3.8-27b` | the llama.cpp seat a box WITHOUT the vLLM venv serves instead |

### Cache server

This seat is backed by a KV **cache server**: a context that leaves VRAM comes back from
the store instead of being recomputed, and it survives a seat swap.

| setting | value |
|---|---|
| store | `fs_native` |
| address | `/mnt/kvcache/lmcache-seat-tp2-fp8` |
| chunk_size | 1568 — must equal the engine's unified block size at this KV dtype |
| l1_staging_gb | 2 |
| key_prefix | `qube-seat-tp2-fp8` |
| min_mbps | 200 — below this the seat DEGRADES to the same-box L1 tier, loudly (0.115.1); it never refuses to start |

The store is a second device and stays **optional**: a box without one runs the seat on
VRAM plus the L1 staging buffer.

> The SAME seat blackwell-3x16 seeds, on the same silicon: the RTX 5060 Ti pair. On the 3-card reference box the pair is devices 0,2 (PCI order, the 5070 Ti display card sits at 1); on a 2-card box it is 0,1. Every operating-point number carries over unchanged — vLLM 0.28.0 + LMCache MP 0.5.5rc3, fp8 KV with the PR #4253 overlay, window 163,840 at util 0.90 (fp8 pool 177,766 tokens), batched 3135, seqs 32, the Lenovo fs_native cache server over the wired SMB path (570 MB/s, SEAT_L2_MIN_MBPS 200). Re-confirmed on the pair 2026-09-08 (Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-09-08-blackwell-2x16-fit/, arm P): util 0.85 -> Available KV cache memory 2.32 GiB = 141,266 tokens; non-KV 11.22 GiB per TP2 worker. HISTORY, so it is not repeated: harness 0.114.1 (same day, hours earlier) declared this tier had NO vllm_seat after an arm that spanned the 5070 Ti display card at a floor-respecting util 0.50 (Available KV -3.36 GiB). That arm answered a question this tier does not ask — the tier's two cards are the 5060 Ti pair, never the display card — and the operator overturned it the same afternoon. The display-card numbers stay in that record as the reason no seat is ever pinned to the 5070 Ti. UTILIZATION CORRECTED 2026-09-14 (0.118.1, A-22): this seat carried gpu_memory_utilization 0.9 COPIED from blackwell-3x16, and vLLM has ONE utilization for every rank, so the figure only means what the cards it spans are also doing. On the 3-card box the pair is devices 0 and 2 and the DISPLAY card is outside the seat entirely, which is what makes 0.90 soak-verified there (10/10 cold loads plus a 20-minute soak; 0.92 lifted the pool ~10% but did not stay stable; 0.95 cannot initialise beside the mem0 embedder). On a TWO-card box the pair IS every card the machine has, so one of the two is also drawing the desktop - the failure mode is measured: on 2026-09-04 a 3-card engine at util 0.87-0.90 left the display card under 1 GB, Windows fell to a 720p-class mode and the box needed a reboot (clean event log, no TDR: starvation, not a crash). The TWO-card operating point was measured on the pair itself, same silicon, arm P (fcc5a6f9-part2 #25, 2026-09-08 16:45, log arm-P-utility-pair-util0.85.log): util 0.85 -> "Available KV cache memory: 2.32 GiB", "GPU KV cache size: 141,266 tokens", "Maximum concurrency for 131,072 tokens per request: 1.08x" - a pool that still clears one full-window request. Arm F (devices 1+2, util 0.50) was VOID at -3.36 GiB and measures nothing. 0.85 is therefore what a FRESH 2-card install seeds; it is not a correction to the reference box, whose pair seat runs 0.90 under the H-24 stability soak and is NOT redeployed by this change. Gated by TestDualBlackwellSeedsThePairSeatWithTheCacheServer, which until now asserted the two tiers' utilizations were IDENTICAL - the assertion that kept the copy in place.

## Media

This tier serves these media **seats** — models in its own llama-swap config, rendered
at install time. Each seat also produces the harness config binding that routes to it, so a
binding can never name a seat that was not rendered:

| seat | kind | binds | model | residency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qwen3-vl-8b` | vision | `vision_model` | `Qwen3VL-8B-Instruct-Q8_0.gguf` | swappable |
| `whisper-stt` | stt | `stt_model` | `ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin` | resident |

A seat still needs its weights on the box — model downloads stay out-of-band, as with
every seed.

## Operator notes

Recorded with the profile — several are measurements from real hardware,
including reasons a tempting change was deliberately not made.

> agent_ctx_tokens 163840 (2026-09-10) = the served window of the declared vLLM seat (was 131072, an under-declaration that sized every contract to 80 percent of the seat). No long twin on this tier: the third card is what buys the 262k window (blackwell-3x16.long_ctx_size). Config #16 (2x homogeneous Blackwell 16GB; the reference box IS the workstation: RTX 5070 Ti 16GB ~896 GB/s + RTX 5060 Ti 16GB ~448 GB/s x8-electrical, PCIe Gen3 X299, quad-channel DDR4-3400, 128GB, no iGPU so the UTILITY card pays the desktop/DWM ~0.5-1.5GB tax). Full design + arithmetic: Drive Local-Offload-Harness/2026-08-02-blackwell-2x16-tier-research.md. TOPOLOGY IS PIN-DON'T-SPLIT: every seat fits one card and is pinned whole (splitting a fits-on-one-card model costs 20-33% tg — sequential per-token pipeline, harmonic-mean arithmetic, verified); the fast card holds the latency primaries + vision, the utility card holds the memory-stack residents + STT + desktop. The STT seat is residency=resident ON PURPOSE: it lives on the OTHER card, so it may run concurrently with any fast-card model — that concurrency is the second card's payoff for this route. DEVICE IDENTITY: pins are PCI_BUS_ID indices matching the reference box (0=5060 Ti, 1=5070 Ti); verify with nvidia-smi after any slot change or BIOS reset (this board wipes settings on AC loss) and substitute GPU UUIDs if enumeration moved — a silent flip inverts every placement. MEASURED verdicts carried from the single-GPU era and still binding: self-built CUDA 12.8 sm_120 build mandatory; no spec-decode except where llama.cpp has the model's MTP graph (Qwen3.5/3.6 yes, DeepSeek-class measured dead here); mmap (never --no-mmap/--mlock) for 70GB+ models + a warm-up request + a wait-for-RAM guard; all-experts-CPU wins for V4-Flash-class MoE until an -ot A/B on THIS Gen3-x8 link proves otherwise; -b/-ub 2048, threads 18; q4_0 KV banned; vision mmproj F16 only. SEAT LIFECYCLE (house rule 2026-08-02): every seat here is the measured INCUMBENT; challengers enter ONLY via documented bake-off in Benchmarks and Optimizations/. SEAT VERDICTS LANDED (2026-08-12..14, tier-matrix catch-up): IMAGE incumbent is now Krea 2 Turbo bf16 (24.5GB, 8-step turbo recipe) — won the blinded 32GB bake-off 2-0-2 over Qwen-Image-2512 (editorial + text-rendering pairs; record in Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-08-14-nightshift4-notes.md), bound via DisTorch2 ratio pooling (the imagegen_pool_* seed keys; --disable-dynamic-vram stays mandatory on both launch surfaces) in harness 0.59.0. HiDream-O1 leaves this tier's seat but REMAINS the proven binding for every single-16GB tier (24.5GB does not fit one card — do not propagate the krea2 seed downward). VIDEO seat BOUND 2026-08-14/15 (Seat Frontier Leg 3, executing the 2026-08-12 verdict; binding mode DECIDED BY OPERATOR 2026-08-15): videogen_family=ltx25 — LTX-2.5 22B distilled int8, two-pass latent-upscale joint-AV graph, POOLED per house doctrine AT REDUCED RESOLUTION (1280x704@24fps — the doctrine outranks the resolution). Measured constraint driving this: the int8 transformer UPCASTS TO BF16 AT COMPUTE = 39.11GB LOADED (DisTorch's own analysis), exceeding the 32GB physical pool — at 1920x1088 no virtual_vram_gb value fits weights AND full-res stage-2 activations (three renders OOM'd). At 1280x704 with videogen_pool_vvram_gb=30 the pooled render is behavior-proven: 5.04s + AAC joint audio in 189.8s, donor 11.8GiB + compute 10.5GiB live, zero OOM. Pooled serving still requires the --disable-dynamic-vram launch flag (MultiGPU #191). Full-res 1920x1088 remains reachable via the STREAMING alternative (pool keys unset, dynamic VRAM on — measured 210s and 1.65-2.3x faster for bf16 graphs) as a per-deployment choice; this tier seeds the doctrine-conformant pooled recipe. Wan 2.2 weights stay on disk as the --model wan fallback family. CODER+AGENT seats DECIDED 2026-08-14 (Seat Frontier Leg 1, measured): Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL (16.7GB pooled, thinking) WON both — coder vs Qwen3-Coder-30B (v3 decision set 14/16 vs 7/16; actioneval e2e 9/9 vs 7/9; loser's GGUF deleted per the disk rule) and agent vs the 31B-agent seat (custody paired D1 tie 15/15-15/15 at -39% output tokens / -31% wall; actioneval 9/9 vs 8/9; 31B-agent entry kept as rollback). Its vision competence is NOT seat-grade (visioncanary Arm A 3/10 under non-thinking budgets) — qwen3-vl-8b keeps the vision seat. Named challengers still awaiting bake-off: escalation Gemma-4-31B-QAT UD-Q4_K_XL (17.3GB, split) vs the 12b/26b rungs; reasoning Qwen3.6-27B Q6_K (22.5GB split, 64KB/token KV); agentic Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-MTP ~70GB; speed gpt-oss-120b MXFP4; vision Qwen3-VL-32B Q4 (19.8GB split); STT DECIDED 2026-08-14 (Leg 2): whisper-large-v3-turbo took the ONE stt seat — house A/B (EN+ES, short + 90-126s long, language-hinted, paired) was a quality tie on every clean slot, long-form chunking parity confirmed, and whisper is the capability superset (segments/SRT/VAD); Qwen3-ASR deleted, harness stt_model_hq cleared (hq falls back by design); a field-audio (noisy) round may re-open the accuracy tier; TTS Qwen3-TTS 1.7B (Spanish) + Higgs Audio v3; video-frontier Wan 2.7 + HunyuanVideo 1.5 (recorded as future challengers only — no re-contest unless the operator asks). RETIRED 2026-08-14 (operator-approved, ledger 0-usage): DeepSeek V4-Flash (capacity seat removed outright — the frontier-challenger slot is VACANT, not awaiting V4) and gpt-oss-20b. Media gen takes BOTH cards under the ADR 0018 machine-wide lease (operator rule: never fence media onto one card). Review 2026-08-02 corrections baked in: videogen_frames stays at the PROVEN 81 (121-frame clips are part of the Wan fp16 challenger bake-off, not a seed); resident_tier is the 26B like every 16GB-class sibling; and the classifier ENFORCES the 16GB band (a 2x 8GB or 2x 32GB Blackwell pair falls to dual-gpu - VRAM is the largest card's, so a mixed 16+8 pair is a known detection limit). This backend has no Linux template yet (same class as dual-cuda). PROJECTED as a tier; the reference box is live — promote values to measured as the bake-offs land. TIER-DOCTRINE PASS 2026-08-16: agent_model seeded explicitly to the measured Leg-1 winner (qwen3.8-27b) — a fresh install previously derived the deposed 26b-a4b. CONTEXT RAISED 32768 -> 131072, 2026-09-07 (operator rule: install defaults follow measurement upward). The reference box for this tier is the live Qube workstation, and its llama-swap serves THIS TIER'S OWN seeded agent model at 131072 (qwen3.8-27b --ctx-size 131072), the 26B-class resident at 131072 (gemma-4-26b-agent), and the same 27B weights at 262144 on the long-context twin - so the old 32768 was an un-raised default, not a fit limit, and this tier's own note already said to promote values as the bake-offs land. NOT propagated to blackwell-16/volta-16/dual-gpu: that 131072 was measured on the TWO-card pool and nothing has measured a 26B at 131072 on ONE 16 GB card. NOT propagated to ampere-16: its 131072 datum is from the persistent vLLM seat, which setup/templates/vllm-seat/ documents as a MANUAL pattern (no installer path renders it), so a fresh install there still gets the llama.cpp 4B seat measured at 32768. vLLM SEAT SEEDED 0.114.2 (2026-09-08, operator correction of 0.114.1): the agent seat is the SAME 27B vLLM TP2 seat blackwell-3x16 seeds, on the 5060 Ti pair (device 0,1 here; 0,2 on the 3-card box), WITH the Lenovo LMCache cache server — every Qube-class tier benefits from the cache server, that is the point of the tier. 0.114.1 had declared NO vllm_seat after measuring TP2 across the 5070 Ti display card; that arm answered a question this tier does not ask and was overturned the same afternoon (record: Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-09-08-blackwell-2x16-fit/). Pair re-confirmed the same day: util 0.85 -> 2.32 GiB KV = 141,266 tokens, non-KV 11.22 GiB per worker. Gated by TestDualBlackwellSeedsThePairSeatWithTheCacheServer. FAN-OUT TWIN WIRED 2026-09-14 (0.118.1, A-70): the llama.cpp 27B seat shipped `--parallel 1` and is FLAT under fan-out - 34.6-37.4 tok/s aggregate at c1..c32, and it answers 429 from c16 (6 of 16 and 22 of 32 requests failed in the baseline arm). The measured operating point on the SAME pair is `--parallel 8` at the SAME `-c` (arm par8-pair, 2026-09-01, `llamacpp-par8-pair.json`, ledger "FAIRNESS ARM par8-pair"): W1 43.4 tok/s (unchanged single-stream) and aggregate 78.7 / 110.8 / 100.7 / 106.8 at c4/8/16/32, 0 failures - about 3x aggregate under fan-out. IT SHIPS AS A SEPARATE ENTRY, `qwen3.8-27b-par8`, NOT as a flag on the seat, and that is the whole decision: llama.cpp divides `-c` among its slots, so eight slots at --ctx-size 131072 serve 16,384 tokens EACH. The same night's Lenovo arm proves the mechanism in-house (`--parallel 8 -c 32768`: "16k/32k prompts exceed the 4k/slot window"). Putting `--parallel 8` on the seat itself would therefore cut this tier's declared fallback agent lane (fallback_agent_model qwen3.8-27b, fallback_agent_ctx_tokens 131072) to 16,384 while the profile still advertised 131,072 - the advertise-more-than-you-serve defect that shipped once already on blackwell-8. Both entries are swappable alternatives at ttl 300, so the twin costs nothing until something asks for it. NOT --parallel 16: on this pair it FAILS TO START at `-c 131072` (5.0 GB recurrent-state cache) and at `-c 65536`, and needs `-c 49152` + `--tensor-split 27,23` to run at all, for 119 vs 111 at c16. NOT --parallel 32: infeasible, ~350 MB of GDN recurrent state PER SLOT (an 11.3 GB rs buffer beside ~9 GB of weights on a 16 GB card). Gated by TestPairSpanningTemplatesShipTheMeasuredFanoutTwin.
